title: SAFECOM Reporting System

nodes.text: Use SAFECOM system for accident prevention by reporting any condition, observance, act, maintenance problem, or circumstance with potential to cause aviation accident

evidence.source_text: The purpose of the SAFECOM system is accident prevention. It is a tool used to encourage the reporting of any condition, observance, act, maintenance problem, or circumstance that has the potential to cause an aviation or aviation-related accident.

nodes.text: Report positive safety actions and mishap prevention measures using SAFECOM

evidence.source_text: It can also be used for reporting positive safety actions and mishap prevention measures.

nodes.text: Address problems and issues at the local level and share problems and solutions system wide

evidence.source_text: Submitting a SAFECOM is not a substitute for on-the-spot correction(s) to a safety concern. While it is imperative that problems and issues be addressed at the local level, it is beneficial to share problems and solutions system wide.

nodes.text: Ensure SAFECOM system is not used for initiating punitive actions

evidence.source_text: The SAFECOM system is not intended for initiating punitive actions.

nodes.text: SAFECOM managers protect personal data and sanitize SAFECOMs before public posting

evidence.source_text: SAFECOM managers are responsible for protecting personal data and sanitizing SAFECOMs prior to posting to the public.

nodes.text: Report any interagency aircraft mishap to 1-888-464-7427 (1-888-4MISHAP)

evidence.source_text: Report any interagency aircraft mishap to: 1-888-464-7427 (1-888-4MISHAP).
